TAGLINE: Mechanistic pruning experiments for separating compression that preserves general perplexity from compression that preserves reasoning circuits.
OVERVIEW: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers and MLP widths are elastic, critical, or reasoning-specific. The current focus is Mistral-7B compression that survives GSM8K rather than merely preserving C4 perplexity.

Phase 16 showed the central failure mode: 20% hardware-aligned width pruning kept C4 perplexity in a plausible range but collapsed 5-shot GSM8K from 38.7% to about 5%. That is a useful negative result because it separates general language retention from reasoning-circuit retention.

Phase 25 auxiliary scaling complete. Uniform structural width pruning collapses GSM8K even at 1%, while tensor-preserving masks expose a much higher-retention boundary. The strongest positive control is Mistral 20% layerwise mask sparsity with 37.2% full GSM8K versus 38.7% dense; the standard 20% global magnitude baseline reaches 35.3%, confirming retention but showing layerwise allocation matters. The extended auxiliary check keeps the 20% layerwise mask essentially tied with dense on 300 GSM8K Platinum examples and full BBH multistep arithmetic.
RESEARCH_Q: Where is the Mistral-7B GSM8K reasoning-retention boundary under tensor-preserving masks, and why does layerwise allocation outperform a standard global magnitude threshold?
PHASE: Phase 25 Validation: extended auxiliary reasoning check complete
RUNS: Phase 15 — True Layer Dropping & Boundary Healing
DECISIONS: We shifted focus to Mistral-7B and Llama-3-class architectures, where compression failures are meaningful for modern reasoning deployments.
Phase 18B and Phase 19 now form a controlled contrast: C4-matched structural and masked models can have very different GSM8K retention.
To ensure theoretical FLOP reductions translate to physical speedups, we round pruned MLP dimensions to nearest 64 (Tensor Core alignment) via specific ceil/floor strategies.
TASKS: 20% layerwise mask full GSM8K is strong at 37.2% strict EM versus 38.7% dense. The standard 20% global magnitude mask reaches 35.3%, weaker than layerwise by 1.9 points but far above 20% structural width pruning.

Depth-band dense reverts from the 25% layerwise mask are indistinguishable at n=300. MLP revert is the best point estimate at 40.0% strict EM, but overlaps attention and depth-band confidence intervals, so report distributed or weakly localized recovery.
Global unstructured magnitude pruning at 20.06% actual linear sparsity reaches 35.33% strict EM on full GSM8K with C4 PPL 8.203.
Initial mask-guided structural pruning failed: 0.45% and 0.89% MLP sparsity reached only 24% and 10% GSM8K smoke, so larger points are stopped by default.

The 20% mask is essentially tied with dense on the larger auxiliary check: 38.00% vs 38.33% on 300 GSM8K Platinum examples and 33.60% vs 32.40% on full BBH multistep arithmetic. Keep this as support, not the primary claim.
Llama-3-8B GSM8K smoke is near dense at 10% mask sparsity (49% vs 53%, n=100) but drops at 20% (29%), so the Mistral 20% safe point should not be reported as universal.

Use COLM Efficient Reasoning as the technical target, but confirm remote or proxy presentation before committing to that venue because the workshop page says hybrid while the COLM FAQ is in-person-first.
